copy.subject: 想詢問一個小型、無費用的『更正與後續狀態』查核流程測試
copy.problem: Public-source matters fragment over time: initial reports or notices are easy to find, while later responses, corrections, superseding records, proceedings and outcomes may live on different pages and dates, forcing analysts to reconstruct the same history repeatedly.
copy.solution: Nocturnal maintains a source-linked matter history with previous/current documented state, chronology, corrections/disputes, later outcomes, historical as-of reconstruction and Before/After comparison, without browser-side truth, credibility, guilt or reputation scoring.

interface.now: Readable current state and materially changed matters.
interface.read: What changed?, chronology, evidence, corrections/disputes, current documented state and historical as-of views.
interface.research: Read-only Timeline, Before/After, Subjects, Sources and Evidence inspection.

copy.excluded_preview_reason: Superseded Edition/RC1 hosted preview; it does not expose the canonical Now → Read → Research path and must not be used as the TFC product demo.
copy.message:
台灣事實查核中心您好：

我是 Christopher Ongko，目前在元智大學就讀碩士班，也是 Nocturnal 的開發者。

Nocturnal 想處理的不是一般搜尋問題，而是『同一件公共資訊事件後來發生了什麼』。一件事件可能先有新聞、公告或指控，之後的回應、更正、修訂、程序結果或結案資訊卻分散在不同頁面與時間點。分析人員因此常需要重新拼湊整段歷史，也可能很容易找到最初事件，卻漏掉後來真正改變目前狀態的資料。

Nocturnal 的做法是把這些資料維持在同一個有來源連結的 matter history 裡，而不是只留下彼此分散的搜尋結果。介面分成三個閱讀深度：Now 先呈現目前狀態與最近的重要變化；Read 顯示 What changed?、完整時間軸、證據、更正/爭議與歷史 as_of 狀態；Research 則提供唯讀的 Timeline、Before/After、Subjects、Sources 與 Evidence 檢查。系統不做真假、可信度、罪責或名譽評分。

專案： https://github.com/Spectating101/nocturnal-oversight
Evaluator guide： https://github.com/Spectating101/nocturnal-oversight/blob/main/EVALUATOR_GUIDE.md

目前軟體與介面已完成到適合做外部測試的階段，所以我下一步希望驗證它是否真的對實際工作有幫助，而不是再增加功能。想詢問貴中心是否願意用一個規模很小、無費用、由貴中心自行選擇的非敏感公開資料案例做測試；最好是有明確更新、更正或後續結果的事件。

我們只比較幾個具體項目：重建目前狀態所需時間、找到支持來源所需時間、更正或取代資訊是否更容易被發現、是否減少重複查找，以及分析過程中的錯誤或遺漏。這不是要請貴中心替專案背書；如果結果顯示 Nocturnal 沒有幫助，對我而言同樣是有效結果。

如果這個問題與貴中心的工作有關，我可以先安排約 30 分鐘的介面與 evaluator protocol 示範，再由貴中心決定是否值得進一步做小型測試。

謝謝您閱讀。

Christopher Ongko
元智大學
s1133958@mail.yzu.edu.tw
copy.message_en:
Hello Taiwan FactCheck Center team,

I am Christopher Ongko, a master's student at Yuan Ze University and the developer of Nocturnal.

The problem Nocturnal is designed around is something ordinary search handles poorly: a public matter may begin with one report or official notice, but later responses, corrections, revised records and final outcomes often appear on different pages and at different times. Reconstructing the current documented state can therefore mean repeatedly rebuilding the same history from scattered sources.

Nocturnal keeps those records attached to one source-linked matter history. Its public interface has three depths: Now shows the current readable state, Read shows What changed?, chronology, evidence and historical views, and Research provides read-only Timeline, Before/After, Subjects, Sources and Evidence inspection. It does not generate truth, credibility, guilt or reputation scores.

Repository: https://github.com/Spectating101/nocturnal-oversight
Evaluator guide: https://github.com/Spectating101/nocturnal-oversight/blob/main/EVALUATOR_GUIDE.md

The software/product side is now complete enough that the useful next step is an external workflow test rather than another feature sprint. Would someone at TFC be open to a very small, no-cost pilot using one bounded, non-sensitive, correction-rich public-information case of your choice?

We would compare the normal workflow with Nocturnal on concrete measures: time to reconstruct the current state, time to recover supporting sources, whether corrections or superseding records are noticed, repeated checking avoided, and analyst error/missed-context notes. A negative result would be just as useful; I am not asking TFC to endorse the project.

If the problem is relevant to your work, I can first give a roughly 30-minute walkthrough of the interface and evaluator protocol, and you can decide afterward whether a pilot is worth doing.

Thank you for considering it.

Christopher Ongko
Yuan Ze University
s1133958@mail.yzu.edu.tw
copy.pilot_summary: One no-cost bounded public-source workflow comparison over a correction-rich non-sensitive case, measuring current-state reconstruction time, source-recovery time, correction/supersession visibility, duplicate checking avoided, and analyst error notes.
